section: Important things you should keep in mind about these benefits:

rows.Benefits Description.Accidental injury b: We cover restorative services and supplies necessary to promptly repair but not replace sound natural teeth. The need for these services must result from an accidental injury. • Repair to sound natural teeth such as expenses for x-rays, drugs, crowns, bridgework, inlays and dentures. Notes: • We may review x-rays and/or treatment records in order to determine benefit coverage. • See sections 5(a) through 5(f) for applicable services and benefits.

rows.Benefits Description.Accidental injury b: Not covered: • Oral implants and transplants • Masticating (biting or chewing) incidents are not considered to be accidental injuries.
